definitions.explanation: Being vulnerable to or not skilled at something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弱|よわ}いです。
examples.english: I have a weak body / I'm not very healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱|よわ}いです。
examples.english: I can't hold my alcohol well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱|よわ}いです。
examples.english: I can't handle the heat well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弱|よわ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Babies have weak bodies, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱|よわ}いです。⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧です。
examples.english: I'm not a morning person. It's hard to get up every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弱|よわ}く⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弱|よわ}い。
⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱|よわ}い。
⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱|よわ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I can't handle the cold, so I don't like winter.

examples.japanese: {弱|よわ}い⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}て→煮る：01971_niru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{弱|よわ}い is an i-adjective meaning weak or not good at something.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {弱|よわ}く
- Noun form: {弱|よわ}さ (weakness)
- Negative: {弱|よわ}くない

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{弱|よわ}い: weak against ~, susceptible to ~, not good with ~
- お{酒|さけ}に{弱|よわ}い: can't hold alcohol well
- {朝|あさ}に{弱|よわ}い: not a morning person
- {暑|あつ}さに{弱|よわ}い: can't handle heat

COMPOUNDS:
- {弱点|じゃくてん}: weak point, weakness
- {弱気|よわき}: timidity, bearish (stock market)
- {弱虫|よわむし}: coward, weakling

OPPOSITE:
{強|つよ}い: strong
